title: Project Organica — a developmental-structure engine and its preregistered evidence record
description: Project Organica is a Python engine that grows a graph of typed structural candidates across sleep cycles and can revise them under later evidence. This record is the v0.12.0 snapshot: the engine as it stands at the archived commit, together with the preregistered evidence record — the belief-revision comparison against simple baselines (Phase K), the plasticity-coherence sweep (Phase L), the acquisition-benchmark audits, the Gate 13 relation-ranking analyses, and the formation-versus-utilization campaign. The archival reference for the frozen Organica 1 engine is the v0.9.0 tag, and the engine has advanced past that freeze; the build behind each result artifact is recorded with the artifact where it was captured. The engine uses only the Python standard library.
notes: Archived from the commit recorded as software_commit in the deposit manifest. v0.12.0 is cut and tagged; the commit SHA recorded in the manifest is the identifier. v0.9.0 remains the archival reference for the frozen Organica 1 engine alone, and v0.9.0 is the latest published release (the v0.10.0 tag has no GitHub release page). The engine in this record is not byte-identical to v0.9.0: the sleep path was rewritten and the candidate-supersession amendment is recorded with its measured effect in docs/V1-FREEZE.md section 6.
